name: Inquisitor Progressionist
body:
Progressionists espouse the urbanization of wildlands with strict adherence to law and order as key to ushering in an age of civilized life. As civilization advances with improvements in engineering, commerce, and diplomatic overtures, anarchy retreats and a perfected society emerges.

A progressionist has the following class features.

Special

A progressionist cannot be chaotic in alignment.

Model Citizen

A progressionist is schooled in the ways of polite society. A progressionist gains Knowledge (engineering), Knowledge (history), Knowledge (local), Knowledge (nobility), and Linguistics, but does not gain Disguise, Knowledge (nature) and Survival.

This alters class skills.

Diplomatic Discourse (Ex)

A progressionist spends many hours exercising patience and presenting thoughtfully conceived, fair arguments at the bargaining table. At 1st level, a progressionist gains a competence bonus on Diplomacy skill checks equal to 1/2 his progressionist level (minimum 1). He also uses his Wisdom bonus in place of Intelligence to determine the number of bonus languages he receives.

This replaces stern gaze.

Money Talks (Sp)

At 2nd level, when casting a spell, a progressionist can spend coins to increase his effective caster level with that spell by 1. Increasing his caster level in this manner costs a progressionist 1 copper for 1st level spells, 1 gold for 2nd–5th level spells, and 3 gold for 6th–9th level spells.

The progressionist must have any required coins in his possession (they can be in a pouch, on his person, or his own bag of holding). Coins spent to activate this ability are consumed as material components of the spell when used.

Eschew Materials does not reduce this cost.

A progressionist can use this ability as a free action, once per round, up to 3 times per day, plus one additional time at 11th level.

This replaces cunning initiative.

Numerical Order (Su)

Progressionists engage in extensive study of the fundamental laws of numerical operations. At 2nd level, a progressionist can predetermine the outcome of certain die rolls. Once per day, he can take 10 on any skill check.

Beginning at 5th level, he can take 20 instead.

A progressionist can also predict his enemies in such a way as to minimize the damage they deal to him. Once per day, when a creature hits, but does not critically hit, the progressionist with a melee or ranged attack, he can treat all damage dice as if they rolled 2s as a result. The progressionist must declare that he is using this ability before any damage is rolled. Beginning at 5th level, he treats the dice results as 1s instead.

This replaces track.

Power of Cooperation (Su)

At 9th level, a progressionist casts all communal and mass spells at +1 caster level. Furthermore, once per day, a progressionist can grant his judgment benefits to a single ally that he is aware of within 60 feet as an immediate action. A progressionist must have a judgment (or judgments) active to use this ability and the benefits granted are the same as those selected by his judgment. The benefits to both parties end concurrently when the judgment ends for the progressionist. Using this ability does not affect the number of uses of judgment a progressionist has per day. At 15th level, the progressionist can target a number of allies up to his Wisdom modifier with this ability.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at 9th and 15th level.

Stamp Out Chaos (Ex)

At 14th level, a progressionist gains a +4 morale bonus to confirm critical hits against chaotic creatures. On a successful critical hit, the progressionist’s weapon is treated as axiomatic for the purpose of calculating damage and overcoming Damage Reduction.

This replaces exploit weakness.
